title: Server crashed under load at 20 connections
expected: GET /api/stats keeps responding (or degrades with 503s) under 20 concurrent connections
actual: Server stopped accepting connections during the "soak-6" phase of the soak load test and came back after 8.5 s.

source.why: Stats retains every visit and scans its full history, but soak wall duration was 2596s for a requested 180s. Concurrent work and scheduling interruption prevent confidently attributing the reported crash. Kept unconfirmed.
